platforms: source only; no prebuilt library artifact
rust.evidence: Full source suites run on Ubuntu and macOS release runners; other Rust targets are not implied. The four storage crates (jacs-duckdb, jacs-redb, jacs-postgresql 0.1.20; jacs-surrealdb 0.1.21) are published against jacs 0.13.0.

cli.evidence: Release jobs build each listed target, run a launch smoke, and install the staged archive through the Python and Node CLI installers (sign/verify smoke on Unix only: the trust model refuses to create key files on Windows). cargo install remains a source build.

python.evidence: glibc wheels are built inside the pinned manylinux_2_28 images; release candidate smokes install and sign/verify on Ubuntu x86_64 and arm64, macOS x86_64 and arm64, and Alpine x86_64. No Windows or arm64 musllinux wheel is recorded.

node.evidence: Source CI runtime-smokes Node 20 on Ubuntu x86_64. Other listed native binaries are not runtime-smoked here.

platforms: browser source build; release package unavailable
wasm.evidence: Source CI builds wasm32 and runs Firefox plus Chromium/Playwright tests; Safari and Windows-hosted browsers are unverified.

go.evidence: Release publishes libjacsgo for each listed target with SHA-256 digests and GitHub attestations; consumer smokes passed on Ubuntu x86_64 and arm64 and macOS x86_64. The macOS arm64 consumer smoke failed only because its Go 1.21 toolchain cannot run on macOS 26 (fixed for the next release).
